title: Find a file on your own
objective: Choose an open file for either rook in a fresh position.

commentary_source.name: Uroschess original transfer exercise
commentary_source.attribution: Original practice position and teaching text; not a historical game

steps.explanation: The kings are sheltered by pawns. Look for a file with no pawns of either colour, then give one of your rooks that clear route.
steps.coach_prompt: Take a moment to find your own move.

question.prompt: Move either rook onto an open file.
hints: Check each file for white and black pawns.
The c-, d- and e-files are open. Either rook can reach them.

question.other_legal_move_text: That move is legal. Look again at the goal: Move either rook onto an open file.

takeaway: An open file has no pawns of either colour. More than one useful rook move may be possible.
